test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which part of the Indian constitution talks about the Union Territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Part VIII.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Part VIII:-**

 
 
• **Part VIII of the Indian Constitution talks about the Union Territories.**
 
• Articles 239 to 242 of the Constitution deal with the administration of Union Territories.
 
• Under Article 239, the President is responsible for the administration of Union Territories, acting through an Administrator appointed by him.
